svg.aria-label: Stack. Languages: Java, Python, C# / .NET, Kotlin, C++, SQL. Backend: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Swagger, REST APIs, Temenos, WalletConnect. Frontend & mobile: React, Vite, Flutter, Jetpack Compose. Databases: Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, ER modeling. Data & ML: pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Plotly, Folium, Power BI. AI & automation: n8n, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw. DevOps: Docker, nginx, Prometheus, Grafana, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions. Security: Kali Linux, OWASP testing, JWT auth, Red Hat Linux. Embedded & IoT: Linux kernel modules, ARM cross-compiling, ADB.
